items.title: relevant context should not include option_map every time
items.body: Currently it seems like the relevant context computation is simply including things like option_map even when the expected type is specific. It appears that this is because it is the first function in the context that returns `?`. We should probably be more refined in how we choose the relevant context when a specific type is known but there just happen not to be a lot of things in context with such types.

items.title: Inserting new case rule above rule with branch with nullary function ap screws up whitespace
